use_cases: Rotating hero headlines that cycle through marketing messages automatically
Cycling through testimonials or customer quotes with smooth transitions
Displaying rotating feature highlights for product pages
Animated tagline or status message display in dashboards
Carousel-style text announcements in notification areas
ai_summary: TextLoop is a lightweight React component from motion-primitives that automatically cycles through text or content items at configurable intervals. It leverages Framer Motion for smooth Y-axis and opacity transitions, supporting custom animation variants and modes. Ideal for hero sections, testimonials, or any context requiring rotating text content with elegant motion effects.
